key.name: button-width
key.description: Width of the show-desktop bar, in logical pixels.

key.name: edge-margin
key.description: Gap between the bar and the screen edge, in logical pixels. 0 puts it flush in the corner, like Windows.

key.name: corner
key.description: Which bottom corner the bar is pinned to.

key.name: show-separator
key.description: Draw a faint hairline on the inner edge of the bar.

key.name: hover-highlight
key.description: Brighten the bar while the pointer is over it.

key.name: match-dock-height
key.description: Size the bar to the dock's background so it lines up with the icons. When off, or when no dock is found, the bar fills the reserved strip at the bottom of the screen.
